title: Gerund, Infinitive, and Conditional Sentence — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words: enjoys / my sister / in the garden / reading

visual.text: My sister enjoys reading in the garden.

choices.say: My sister enjoys reading in the garden.

visual.text: My sister reading enjoys in the garden.

choices.say: My sister reading enjoys in the garden.

visual.text: Reading my sister enjoys in the garden.

choices.say: Reading my sister enjoys in the garden.

visual.text: In the garden enjoys my sister reading.

choices.say: In the garden enjoys my sister reading.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: decided / to / they / the bridge / repair

visual.text: They decided to repair the bridge.

choices.say: They decided to repair the bridge.

visual.text: They to repair decided the bridge.

choices.say: They to repair decided the bridge.

visual.text: They decided the bridge to repair.

choices.say: They decided the bridge to repair.

visual.text: To repair they decided the bridge.

choices.say: To repair they decided the bridge.

items.reteach: Pola: subjek + decided + to + verb 1 + objek.

items.prompt: Change into conditional type 2: "I don't have time, so I can't help you."

visual.text: If I had time, I could help you.

choices.say: If I had time, I could help you.

visual.text: If I have time, I can help you.

choices.say: If I have time, I can help you.

visual.text: If I had had time, I could have helped you.

choices.say: If I had had time, I could have helped you.

visual.text: If I didn't have time, I couldn't help you.

choices.say: If I didn't have time, I couldn't help you.

items.reteach: Fakta sekarang negatif diubah menjadi type 2 positif: If I had …, I could …

items.prompt: Change into conditional type 3: "She didn't study, so she didn't pass the test."

visual.text: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

choices.say: If she had studied, she would have passed the test.

visual.text: If she studied, she would pass the test.

choices.say: If she studied, she would pass the test.

visual.text: If she studies, she will pass the test.

choices.say: If she studies, she will pass the test.

visual.text: If she hadn't studied, she would have passed the test.

choices.say: If she hadn't studied, she would have passed the test.

items.reteach: Fakta masa lalu negatif menjadi type 3 positif: If + had + verb 3, would have + verb 3.

items.prompt: Change into a wish: "I can't play the guitar."

visual.text: I wish I could play the guitar.

choices.say: I wish I could play the guitar.

visual.text: I wish I can play the guitar.

choices.say: I wish I can play the guitar.

visual.text: I wish I couldn't play the guitar.

choices.say: I wish I couldn't play the guitar.

visual.text: I wish I had played the guitar.

choices.say: I wish I had played the guitar.

items.reteach: Wish tentang sekarang: can menjadi could, dan kalimat dibalik (negatif menjadi positif).

items.prompt: Change into a wish about the past: "I didn't visit Grandma last holiday."

visual.text: I wish I had visited Grandma last holiday.

choices.say: I wish I had visited Grandma last holiday.

visual.text: I wish I visit Grandma last holiday.

choices.say: I wish I visit Grandma last holiday.

visual.text: I wish I hadn't visited Grandma last holiday.

choices.say: I wish I hadn't visited Grandma last holiday.

visual.text: I wish I will visit Grandma last holiday.

choices.say: I wish I will visit Grandma last holiday.

items.reteach: Wish tentang masa lalu: wish + had + verb 3, dengan makna dibalik.

items.prompt: Rewrite using a gerund as the subject: "It is fun to explore Madura by motorbike."

visual.text: Exploring Madura by motorbike is fun.

choices.say: Exploring Madura by motorbike is fun.

visual.text: Explore Madura by motorbike is fun.

choices.say: Explore Madura by motorbike is fun.

visual.text: Explored Madura by motorbike is fun.

choices.say: Explored Madura by motorbike is fun.

visual.text: Is fun exploring Madura by motorbike.

choices.say: Is fun exploring Madura by motorbike.

items.reteach: Pindahkan kegiatan ke depan sebagai gerund: Exploring … is fun.

items.prompt: Rewrite with "let": "Our teacher allowed us to leave early."

visual.text: Our teacher let us leave early.

choices.say: Our teacher let us leave early.

visual.text: Our teacher let us to leave early.

choices.say: Our teacher let us to leave early.

visual.text: Our teacher let us leaving early.

choices.say: Our teacher let us leaving early.

visual.text: Our teacher let us left early.

choices.say: Our teacher let us left early.

items.reteach: Allow + to-infinitive berubah menjadi let + bare infinitive.

items.prompt: Rewrite with "make": "The heavy rain forced us to stay inside."

visual.text: The heavy rain made us stay inside.

choices.say: The heavy rain made us stay inside.

visual.text: The heavy rain made us to stay inside.

choices.say: The heavy rain made us to stay inside.

visual.text: The heavy rain made us staying inside.

choices.say: The heavy rain made us staying inside.

visual.text: The heavy rain made us stayed inside.

choices.say: The heavy rain made us stayed inside.

items.reteach: Force + to-infinitive berubah menjadi make + bare infinitive.

items.prompt: Rewrite with "unless": "If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus."

visual.text: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

choices.say: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.

visual.text: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.

choices.say: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.

visual.text: Unless you hurry, you won't miss the bus.

choices.say: Unless you hurry, you won't miss the bus.

visual.text: Unless you hurried, you will miss the bus.

choices.say: Unless you hurried, you will miss the bus.

items.reteach: Unless = if not, jadi "don't" dihapus: Unless you hurry.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: interested / in / is / joining / Ayu / the robotics club

visual.text: Ayu is interested in joining the robotics club.

choices.say: Ayu is interested in joining the robotics club.

visual.text: Ayu is joining interested in the robotics club.

choices.say: Ayu is joining interested in the robotics club.

visual.text: Ayu in joining is interested the robotics club.

choices.say: Ayu in joining is interested the robotics club.

visual.text: Joining Ayu is interested in the robotics club.

choices.say: Joining Ayu is interested in the robotics club.

items.reteach: Pola: subjek + be + interested in + gerund + objek.

items.prompt: Change into a negative sentence: "He enjoys watching football on TV."

visual.text: He doesn't enjoy watching football on TV.

choices.say: He doesn't enjoy watching football on TV.

visual.text: He doesn't enjoys watching football on TV.

choices.say: He doesn't enjoys watching football on TV.

visual.text: He doesn't enjoy to watch football on TV.

choices.say: He doesn't enjoy to watch football on TV.

visual.text: He not enjoys watching football on TV.

choices.say: He not enjoys watching football on TV.

items.reteach: Negatif simple present: doesn't + verb 1 (enjoy), gerund tetap: watching.

items.prompt: Change into a yes/no question: "They have finished painting the classroom."

visual.text: Have they finished painting the classroom?

choices.say: Have they finished painting the classroom?

visual.text: Did they finished painting the classroom?

choices.say: Did they finished painting the classroom?

visual.text: Have they finish painting the classroom?

choices.say: Have they finish painting the classroom?

visual.text: Have they finished to paint the classroom?

choices.say: Have they finished to paint the classroom?

items.reteach: Present perfect: pindahkan "have" ke depan; finish tetap diikuti gerund.

items.prompt: Combine into conditional type 1: "Maybe it will be sunny. Then we will visit Jatim Park."

visual.text: If it is sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

choices.say: If it is sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

visual.text: If it will be sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

choices.say: If it will be sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

visual.text: If it was sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

choices.say: If it was sunny, we will visit Jatim Park.

visual.text: If it is sunny, we would visit Jatim Park.

choices.say: If it is sunny, we would visit Jatim Park.

items.reteach: Klausa if type 1 memakai simple present, bukan will.
